goal: An unrelated develop move must not require a PR to rewrite repository bookkeeping. Legacy shared aggregates are frozen and may only shrink.

surfaces.reason: Each branch writes an independent note and the trusted bound is a monotonic fold, so concurrent branches do not rewrite one aggregate.
This registry is the explicit policy that classifies collaboration-state representations.
The compliance registry is the reviewed status and evidence specification; changing a claim or evidence record is the substantive compliance change.

Reviewed credential-authority classification: which credential implementation is canonical, reachable, or retired is policy whose change is the substantive change, not a repository-wide measurement that unrelated branches must rewrite.

Reviewed compatibility-window specification: canonical-surface pins and alias dispositions are policy whose change is the substantive change; the fitness suite reads its trusted base through ratchet_provenance, so the candidate copy is not its own oracle.
Reviewed dependency exception specification; changing the exception is the intentional policy change.
Reviewed M1 convergence freeze specification, not a generated measurement.
Explicit governance grants read from the trusted base; authorization is intentionally policy state.
Reviewed retirement specification; changing retirement intent is the substantive change.
Security resource floors are explicit policy values, not repository measurements.
Versioned interoperability ontology is a reviewed specification.
Reviewed per-table retention specification; changing a table's retention claim is the substantive change.
Reviewed per-surface disposition specification; changing a shipped surface's truth classification is the substantive change.

Shrink-only body-status contradiction ratchet (#387): check-adr-status-language-provenance.py compares the candidate measurement against the ledger resolved from the trusted base, so the worktree copy is the landing state rather than an authoritative comparison; concurrent prunes that miss a merge are caught by the stale-entry rule.
The wiring-reads gate measures the candidate but resolves its comparison ledger and authorizations from the trusted base, so editing the candidate copy cannot authorize new unread wiring.

Provenance policy registry (#319): check-ratchet-provenance.py resolves the allow maps that judge a candidate from the trusted base (registry JSON at base, falling back to base inventory source literals), so the worktree copy is landing state, never the oracle.

Workflow quality floors (#319): check-workflow-ratchets.py and check-diff-coverage.py compare candidate measurements against floors resolved from the trusted base; the candidate copy may bank improvements but can never lower a floor.
